better-borg-c.role: The C game and Borg source the bridge attaches to: better-borg-c milestone 8, which carries 88 fixes (patches/series.json). The zoo's newest bbc specimen is 4.2.6-bbc-m7, so there are no zoo results for this build to pair with yet; see PLAN.md T08.

original.role: The original C Borg (angband/angband e473720), the zoo's 4.2.6. Phase 2 reads it; the bridge may be checked against it.

runner.role: The zoo's runner: how a pinned source tree is instrumented, built headless and played. The bridge follows its pattern.

borg-zoo.role: Outcome vocabulary, run-record provenance and the play hash that this repository's records follow (docs/DESIGN.md).

borg-spec.role: The Borg specification and the Tunable Borg Plan: what the remake is meant to be. A source for the playing agent (docs/SOURCES.md, decision D8) and for phases 2 and 3.

sources.note: What the playing agent may read beyond the manual (decision D8, 2026-11-08). Each entry names the pin it is read at, so a claim can cite a fixed commit.

issues.unpinned: The open issues of diegoami/better-borg-c, diegoami/borg-zoo and diegoami/neo-angband-tracker. A claim records the issue number and the date it was read, since a tracker moves.
